get.description: Readiness: the object store answers and the bucket exists.
Every institution, by name, with its last run and when the next is due.

post.description: Adds the institution and makes its website's host a `crawl` domain.

put.description: Replaces the institution's fields; its website's host becomes a `crawl` domain.

post.description:
Queues a full run of the institution from the dashboard. 409 while it has a queued or
running run.

get.description:
The run's numbers, each a query over its logs. Costs come from `ai_calls`: estimated from
the price list, and as reported by OpenRouter.
The run's fetch log, one row per attempt, in the order the requests were made.

The markdown of one page of the snapshot, from 1. 409 while it is being parsed; 404 when
it has no text.
The snapshot's raw bytes, with the media type they were fetched with.
The sources found by the run's classifications, next crawl first.
How many documents the run's classifications found, by type.
The run's paid calls, by purpose, oldest first within each.

AICallOutput.title: AICallOutput
AICallOutput.description: One paid call. `cost` is from the price list; `reported_cost` is what OpenRouter said.

DocumentType.title: DocumentType
DocumentType.description:
What a source lists and what a document is. A `project_material` is assigned by a
project's extraction, never by the classifier.

FetchOutput.title: FetchOutput
FetchOutput.description: One attempt at a URL. `snapshot` is the copy it wrote, if it wrote one.

InstitutionInput.title: InstitutionInput
InstitutionInput.description: What the Add and Edit forms send. The website must be http or https.

OutcomeCount.title: OutcomeCount
OutcomeCount.description: The run's `fetches` rows with one outcome; `requests` are those that sent a request.

ProviderCost.title: ProviderCost
ProviderCost.description:
Like `PurposeCalls`, per provider. `calls_without_reported_cost` are left out of
`reported_cost`.

PurposeCalls.title: PurposeCalls
PurposeCalls.description:
Paid calls for one purpose. `estimated_cost` is USD from the price list; `reported_cost`
is what OpenRouter said it charged, summed over the calls it reported a cost for.

RemovedDocument.title: RemovedDocument
RemovedDocument.description: A document whose webpage first returned 404 in the run.

RunCounts.title: RunCounts
RunCounts.description:
What the run's fetch log and ledger say so far. `skipped` is every `skipped_*` outcome,
`failed` every `failed_*`, `not_modified` includes `unchanged`.

RunCreate.title: RunCreate
RunCreate.description: A run started from the dashboard; only full runs exist until sources do.

RunReport.title: RunReport
RunReport.description:
A run's numbers, each a query over the logs. `elapsed_seconds` is null until the run has
finished. `records`, `unextracted_document_ids` and `fallback_reasons_by_source` are null
while extraction (023) does not exist.

RunSettings.title: RunSettings
RunSettings.description: What a run was asked to do, kept on the run so two runs can be compared.

SourceOutput.title: SourceOutput
SourceOutput.description: A listing page the run found, revisited every `crawl_interval`.
